verdict.rationale: cubic's docs describe interacting in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag @cubic-dev-ai or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation, and the docs show replying to review comments for clarification and commands like `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-thread conversational replies, and detailed documentation of what context the in-thread answers draw on.

support.subject: As a developer, I reply to the reviewer in the PR thread to ask questions, get explanations, or issue commands — and it answers in context

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly, or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation.
Reply to a review comment to ask for clarification
To review a PR that was opened _before_ you installed the app, comment: `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`.
